model_architecture: Lightweight Convolutional U-Net with Skip Connections
clinical_assessment: High Risk / Referable DR (Multiple Microvascular Lesion Classes)

lesions.name: Microaneurysms
lesions.description: Focal punctate dilatations of retinal capillary walls; earliest hallmark of NPDR.

lesions.name: Haemorrhages
lesions.description: Deep intraretinal dot/blot or superficial flame haemorrhages from compromised capillaries.

lesions.name: Hard Exudates
lesions.description: Lipid/lipoprotein transudates extravasated from incompetent vascular walls; DME indicator.

lesions.name: Soft Exudates
lesions.description: Axoplasmic stasis in nerve fiber layer secondary to precapillary arteriolar ischemia.
